features.name: Stable nullable-reference local assignment smart casts
features.scope: Local storage retains its declared nullable type while stable reads retain the inherent assigned reference type. Platform generic results preserve nullability and are evaluated once. Read-only captures preserve facts; reassignment, changing captures, branches and loop writes invalidate facts. Contextual assignment fallback preserves existing lambda checking.

limitations: Nullable reference local assignment keeps the inherent RHS type while storing through the declared type. Stable boxed/read-only captures use the same facts; changing captures and control-flow writes invalidate them. Compound expression effects and writes to boxed locals in loops conservatively lose facts. Primitive narrowing, nullable callable literals and broader intersection/LUB flow remain bounded. No Android runtime or full-app claim.
